text:
amelia: Quick follow-up from today's AH pricing Q&A — thread for short clarifications on quotas, credits, and demo bursts. Ask here and we'll file action items.

natalie: Do trial credits ever auto-renew or extend? Customers asked.

leo: Trials do not auto-renew. Standard trial credit window = 90 days. We can extend case-by-case for strategic trials; sales should route requests via partner-ops.

sam: Are promo credits different? e.g., campaign codes that sales give out.

leo: Promo credits have campaign-specific TTLs (30/60/90 days). We'll make expiry visible in the credits list and include expiry metadata in the API.

raj: Question on rate limits: what's the recommended client behavior on 429?

raj: Recommended: respect Retry-After header when present; otherwise use exponential backoff with jitter. For heavy streaming use, reduce concurrency and batch sizes rather than piling retries.

olivia: For demos: can SEs get temporary elevated concurrency?

olivia: Yes  internal SEs can request demo-boost via the internal tool; auto-approve up to 120 rps for 2 hours. For external demos, open a support ticket with key + window; Ops will provision a capped policy.

natalie: Can credits be applied to Dedicated reserved capacity? Our finance team gets asked this a lot.

leo: By default, Dedicated reservations are invoiced via contract and not consumed from hosted credits. Exceptions possible with finance approval; treat as a special accounting offset, not a standard flow.

amelia: Quick clarifying point: credits are billing units, not control-plane controls. They don't change rate limits or concurrency unless explicitly negotiated in a contract.

billing-bot: Notice: credit-expiry email scheduled rollout 2026-06-02 to 10% of orgs.

amelia: Action items: raj -> publish SDK retry snippet and sandbox vs paid limit table (1w); leo -> add expiry column to billing CSV and show per-credit TTL in UI (2w); olivia -> demo-boost SOP for SEs (2w). I'll reopen if more Qs.
